requiredMarkers: Founder Control Room and Chief AI paired evolution
postingTruthBoundary: A draft, scheduler acceptance, workflow trigger, or model response does not prove publication. A publication claim requires an observable platform artifact and recorded evidence.
postingApprovalPolicy: Material external communication requires a reviewable draft and founder approval unless the founder has explicitly authorized that class of automated publication.
driftPolicy: A material change to either repository requires counterpart review. Unresolved mismatch is pair drift and blocks a complete-state claim.
runtimeTruthBoundary: Passing this static contract proves repository policy alignment only. It does not prove deployed or runtime behavior.
